def upload_clipboard():
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(['xclip', '-selection', 'clipboard', '-o'], capture_output=True, env=ENV, timeout=2)
        text = r.stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').strip()
        if not text:
            text = '(剪贴板为空)'
        requests.get(CLIP_SYNC_URL + '?action=save&text=' + requests.utils.quote(text), allow_redirects=True, timeout=5)
        print('剪贴板已上传')
    except Exception as e:
        print('剪贴板错误: ' + str(e))

def paste_to_doc():
    doc_url = 'https://docs.google.com/document/d/1cV6eqGBgVLj-xK5Z1opY9mr4Sm77zOfjtITPjSlXq1A/edit'
    wid = get_chrome_wid()
    subprocess.run(['xdotool', 'windowfocus', wid], env=ENV)
    time.sleep(0.3)
    subprocess.run(['xdotool', 'key', 'ctrl+t'], env=ENV)
    time.sleep(0.5)
    subprocess.run(['xdotool', 'key', 'ctrl+l'], env=ENV)
    time.sleep(0.3)
    subprocess.run(['xdotool', 'type', '--clearmodifiers', doc_url], env=ENV)
